## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Brownbook's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**

- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

- Access Brownbook data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.brownbook.net (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Brownbook frontend uses
